summary.text: Brian Schatz is Hawai'i's senior U.S. Senator and serves on the Appropriations; Commerce, Science, and Transportation; Foreign Relations; and Indian Affairs committees, among others.

paragraphs.text: Before joining the Senate he was Hawai'i's Lieutenant Governor and served eight years in the Hawai'i State House of Representatives.
He grew up in Honolulu and received his bachelor's degree from Pomona College.
